assessment_summary.cou_name: Rank three diffuser options by pressure rise and outlet swirl at 30–50 L/min with rotor at 18,000 rpm for EVT selection

evidence_keywords: Three unstructured poly-hexcore meshes
1.2M, 3.8M, and 11.5M cells
Extrapolated mesh-converged value ~1031 Pa
estimated GCI on the medium grid 2.4%
observed order ~1.9
pressure-based coupled solver
Residual targets 1e-5; mass imbalance <0.05% of throughflow
350–450 iterations to convergence
Incompressible RANS; k–ω SST with low-Re wall treatment
Rotor modeled as a frozen-rotor MRF zone at 18,000 rpm
Compressibility also ignored
suitable for mean performance only
Mass flow specified at the outlet
total pressure at the inlet (ambient)
turbulence intensity 5% at inlet, 3% at outlet
Air at 25 C, 1.185 kg/m3, μ = 1.85e-5 Pa·s
The tip gap was set to 0.20 mm per drawing
Bench setup: Modified AMCA 210 nozzle rig
5-hole probe 30 mm downstream of the diffuser exit
Three test points: 30/40/50 L/min
Repeatability over three runs gave SD of 11–18 Pa
Mass flow specified at the outlet to match bench points (30/40/50 L/min)
Rotor modeled as a frozen-rotor MRF zone at 18,000 rpm
air properties fixed at 25 C
40 L/min: Test 990 ± 25 Pa; CFD 1005 Pa (+1.5%)
50 L/min: Test 880 ± 30 Pa; CFD 905 Pa (+2.8%)
Outlet yaw angle vs. probe rake average differed by <3 degrees
